scope: All 62 test_*.py modules under pinned hail/hail/python/test/hail, including backend modules; Python API tests, not Hail Scala or hailtop suites. Imports redirected to Vail; init, backend flags, and snapshot fixtures adapted.
limitations: Collection failures and timeouts are not passes.
Per-test timeout 60 seconds, module timeout 600 seconds for pytest.
Supplemental bodies run in isolated subprocesses with a 45-second limit per definition; decorators, imports, fixtures and initialization adapted. These are separate from normal pytest results.
The 131-definition randomness selection uses direct rand_*, shuffle and sampling calls and same-module callers; it does not prove identification of every indirect randomness consumer.
Pass counts for observed pytest cases do not establish all variants executed when a module times out.
